Create one production concept image for the Career World project landmark "xSearch". This is a supporting project building: highly detailed and distinctive, but clearly smaller and less ceremonial than an employer city capital. Research-grounded domain summary: A deliberately simple Manifest V3 browser extension that federated available Confluence, Stack Exchange, Slack, Jira, and Salesforce APIs, normalized responses, and presented aggregated search inside an existing employee workflow. Accepted baseline identity: A long indexing-comb hall uses six parallel archive fins of staggered length beneath one transverse raised query bridge, with an off-center triangular reading tower at the closed end.
